title: Entropic Control for Homeostatic Optimization: Pre-empting Catastrophic Forgetting via Dynamic Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.34182v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) of LLMs suffers from catastrophic forgetting, and prevailing mitigation strategies struggle to reconcile the plasticity-stability dilemma. To address this, we propose Entropic Control for Homeostatic Optimization (ECHO), a closed-loop control framework. By decomposing the KL divergence, we identify output entropy as a dominant observable component of KL variation. This enables us to leverage entropy as a computationally efficient online proxy to monitor forgetting risks in real-time, bypassing expensive reference-model inference. Consequently, ECHO employs an elastic controller that dynamically modulates the gradient weight of replay data via a proportional control law, using deviations from the pre-trained entropic equilibrium as an error signal. translated_title: 稳态优化的熵控制：通过动态反馈预防灾难性遗忘
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的监督微调（SFT）存在灾难性遗忘问题，而现有的缓解策略难以协调可塑性与稳定性之间的困境。为解决这一问题，我们提出了稳态优化的熵控制（ECHO），这是一种闭环控制框架。通过对KL散度进行分解，我们识别出输出熵是KL变化中占主导地位的可观测成分。这使我们能够将熵作为一种计算高效的在线代理指标，实时监测遗忘风险，从而避免昂贵的参考模型推理。因此，ECHO采用了一个弹性控制器，通过比例控制律动态调节回放数据的梯度权重，并将偏离预训练熵平衡的程度作为误差信号。在0.6B至9B参数规模架构上的实证评估表明，ECHO达到了所观测到的可塑性-稳定性边界，并在若干对比中进一步扩展了该边界。
tldr: 提出ECHO闭环控制框架，将输出熵作为KL散度变化的高效在线代理指标，通过比例控制律动态调节回放数据梯度权重，实时预防大模型微调中的灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: ECHO is a closed-loop control framework that leverages output entropy as a computationally efficient online proxy for KL divergence, dynamically modulating replay data gradient weights via a proportional control law to pre-empt catastrophic forgetting in LLM fine-tuning.
